_comment: Files in this repo that are GENERATED from data/*.json, and how to prove each is
still in step. Read by tools/generated_views.py — that file is byte-identical in every
repo that has one (diff it against ~/LocalProjects/health-record/tools/); only this
tools/run-propagators.sh is the RENDER side and has always existed. Nothing ever ran the
CHECK side, which is how index.html could lag data/events.json unnoticed.
NOT listed: bandsintown-upload.csv — regenerated by run-propagators.sh but untracked, so
it cannot drift in git. /bit-upload rebuilds it from scratch every time.

views.note: per-event .ics files, and the ics_url field it writes back into data/events.json
the MusicEvent JSON-LD block — what Google reads to list the shows
google_calendar_url, derived from the same start time as the .ics
the MusicRecording/VideoObject block, from data/band.json releases[]

views.exempt: <lastmod> is today's date by definition — 'stale' has no meaning for it. tools/bump-sitemap.py sets it at deploy time.
